The treads are horizontal surfaces of about 5 rows, and the camera sees no south-facing riser. The only vertical element is the 2-row dark shadow band under each tread, which is fewer than 3 rows, so there is no real front face. Narrow brown dirt strips run along the left and right edges as cut walls.
